properties.description: The node type Inference (rule all / any / k_of_n, k, rule_name, warrant) between its premises (PREMISE_OF) and its one conclusion (CONCLUDES); add_inference writes it in one call and refuses a bad rule or k with the legal values, a missing endpoint, and a circle. Each premise's truth is read three-valued from what reflow2 already computes (a requirement delivered or met, dropped fails; a check passing, failing fails; a decision accepted, rejected or superseded fails; a constraint nothing violates and whose budget is not exceeded; a capability realized and checked; discontinued fails; a concluded node is its steps' verdict, ANY across them; every other type is unknown). The rule is evaluated Kleene-wise, and the check lives in reads that exist: delivery (a requirement a step concludes is delivered when a step holds), every blast radius (`inferences`: broken / weakened / unknown, carried past a fallen conclusion only), get_node on a step (`inference_reading`) and detect_gaps (conclusion_does_not_follow). A circle through the two links is refused on every edge write. A design that records no Inference reports as before. Declared as the derived relation `follows` (schema/derived/relations.yaml), which `delivered` and `impact` are computed over.
properties.name: An Inference step says how premises support a conclusion (all, any, k of n); the roll-up, the change walk and a finding check that the conclusion follows
